title: Weekly overview with multi-series comparison
expectations: Every chart is built from one named local chart component, not several ad-hoc inline chart bodies.
Series colours come from the --color-data-categorical-* tokens in declared order, not from hand-picked hex values or a fresh choice per chart.
Trend direction uses --color-success and --color-error, never a categorical data token.
The page has exactly one Heading level={1}, and it sits in the page header rather than mid-content.
Numbers are formatted through a single shared formatter with an explicit locale, not by hand-rolled toLocaleString calls scattered through the file.
The KPI tile is defined once and reused, ordering value then label then delta, rather than being written out several different ways.
No raw hex colours, pixel values or font sizes appear anywhere, including inside chart library props.
